snippets.summary: So DOTS is a proactive agent, it's always on, always working, you stop working, it keeps working and the kind of thing that my Dots does, right, so I have a Dot that's looking out for work that I was supposed to do, like messages I was supposed to send, things I said I would do that I haven t gotten to yet and I always wake up in the morning, there s like a list of things that I was like, Oh yeah, this is my to do list and it often notices things that I never even asked it to notice.
